name: Icon
description: Accessible SVG icon renderer with a fixed icon catalog, configurable size and optional accessible label.

semantics.nativeAttributes: Map the target framework's class and image attributes to the rendered image element.
semantics.decorativeBehavior: Icons without a label are decorative; labeled icons expose their accessible name.

props.name: name
props.type: alarm | angle-down | angle-right | arrow | box | campain | cards | cart-empty | cart-fill | cart-plus | chart | check | comment | compare | contact-phone | contact | delivery | filtr | handshake | heart | incognito | loader | minus | more | note | plus | price-down | ranking | recycle | search-alt | search-check | search-plus | search | send | set | setting | sort | star | thumb | trash | user | vs | zo
props.description: Name of an SVG from the design-system icon catalog.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered width and height in pixels.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible image alternative text. Omit for a decorative icon.

accessibility: Render label as the image alt text when label is provided.
Render an empty alt and aria-hidden=true when label is omitted.
Keep decorative icons out of the accessibility tree.
Prevent the icon image from being draggable.
adaptationRules: Implement Icon as a reusable component in the target application's framework.
Load the existing SVG assets from the client application's asset pipeline or copy the required assets without changing their names.
Preserve the name-to-file mapping and the special cart-fill multicolor behavior.
Map label to the target framework's native image accessibility API.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any other dependency solely for this component.
